Name: Islands

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the terrain noise used to build the island's beach, forest, and mountain bands.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of the terrain bands that define the island's beaches, forests, and mountains.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create more closely spaced island terrain features.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges the beach, forest, and mountain terrain while preserving the island outline.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different island landscape.

Params.Name: NoiseOctaves
Params.Label: Noise Octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many layers build the beach, forest, and mountain terrain bands.
Params.Tooltip: More layers add richer island terrain detail.

Params.Name: NoiseLacunarity
Params.Label: Noise Lacunarity
Params.Description: Controls the spacing between broad island regions and finer terrain breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values make successive island details smaller.

Params.Name: NoisePersistence
Params.Label: Noise Persistence
Params.Description: Controls how strongly fine beach, forest, and mountain variation remains visible.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values preserve more small-scale island detail.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends the island terrain bands so coast, forest, and mountain boundaries feel more natural.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for less regular terrain boundaries.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in the island terrain bands.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local terrain placement.

Params.Name: CoverageMode
Params.Description: Selects how the shape distributes its major terrain regions.
Params.Tooltip: Choose the coverage mode that matches the desired layout.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: TerrainOctaves
Params.Description: Controls the number of noise octaves used for the terrain foundation.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add finer terrain detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: TerrainScale
Params.Label: Terrain Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the terrain foundation noise.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for smaller terrain features.

Params.Name: TerrainPersistence
Params.Label: Terrain Persistence
Params.Description: Controls how much high-frequency terrain detail is retained.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values preserve more detail in later octaves.

Params.Name: TerrainLacunarity
Params.Label: Terrain Lacunarity
Params.Description: Controls the frequency spacing between terrain noise octaves.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values spread successive detail frequencies farther apart.

Params.Name: BeachCoverage
Params.Label: Beach Coverage
Params.Description: Controls how much of the low terrain is treated as beach.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to expand the beach region.

Params.Name: BeachSteepness
Params.Label: Beach Steepness
Params.Description: Controls the slope response of the beach transition.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust it to control where the beach fades into land.

Params.Name: BeachHeight
Params.Label: Beach Height
Params.Tooltip: Use positive values to raise the band and negative values to carve it.
Params.Description: Controls the vertical contribution of the beach band.

Params.Name: ForestCoverage
Params.Label: Forest Coverage
Params.Description: Controls how much terrain is assigned to the forest band.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to expand the forest region.

Params.Name: ForestSteepness
Params.Label: Forest Steepness
Params.Description: Controls the slope response of the forest transition.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust it to control the forest band's boundary.

Params.Name: ForestHeight
Params.Label: Forest Height
Params.Description: Controls the vertical contribution of the forest band.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to make the forest region more pronounced.

Params.Name: MountainCoverage
Params.Label: Mountain Coverage
Params.Description: Controls how much terrain is assigned to the mountain band.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to expand the mountain region.

Params.Name: MountainHeight
Params.Label: Mountain Height
Params.Tooltip: Use negative values to carve the mountain band downward.
Params.Description: Controls the vertical contribution of the mountain band.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Description: Generates a islands-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
